name: Luminate 2025 U.S. on-demand audio
notes: Values are transcribed from the On-Demand Audio Streams column, not the albums-plus-TEA-plus-SEA column.
The eleven selected genres sum to 83.4%. The rounded 16.6% remainder includes categories not listed in this table; shares are not renormalized.
These are U.S. streaming market shares, not shares of listeners or listener percentiles. Playlist rows are compared with source plays as an approximate composition index.
The project uses an editorial crosswalk to the report categories. The report's World category includes K-pop; the separate Luminate CONNECT taxonomy should not silently replace it.
Broad R&B, Soul & Blues and World families remain ambiguous without specific genre evidence. Blues and other unreported categories receive no invented baseline.
Country may include explicit Folk or Bluegrass under the documented Billboard taxonomy. Broad Modern Folk or Traditional Folk alone is not sufficient.
